package e2e_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"slices"
	"testing"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/shopspring/decimal"

	"github.com/gopherex/ratel"

	"example.com/e2e/db/app"
	"example.com/e2e/db/queries"
	"example.com/e2e/doc"
)

func pool(t *testing.T) *pgxpool.Pool {
	t.Helper()

	config, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(os.Getenv("RATEL_E2E_DSN"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	config.AfterConnect = func(ctx context.Context, conn *pgx.Conn) error {
		if err := app.RegisterTypes(ctx, conn); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		return queries.RegisterTypes(ctx, conn)
	}

	result, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(t.Context(), config)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	t.Cleanup(result.Close)

	return result
}

func TestGenerated(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := t.Context()
	db := ratel.New(pool(t))

	first := app.Users.Row().Email("ann@example.com").Status(app.UserStatusActive).
		Balance(decimal.RequireFromString("12.50")).
		Tags([]string{"a", "b"}).
		Home(ratel.NullFrom(app.Address{Street: ratel.NullFrom("Main"), Zip: ratel.NullFrom("100")})).
		Profile(ratel.NullFrom(doc.Profile{Name: "Ann"}))

	users, err := db.Run(app.Users.Insert(first,
		app.Users.Row().Email("bob@example.com").Status(app.UserStatusOnHold)).Returning()).List(ctx)
	if err != nil || len(users) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("insert = %v, %v", users, err)
	}

	ann, err := db.Run(app.Users.Select().Where(app.Users.Email.Eq("ann@example.com"))).One(ctx)
	if err != nil || !ann.Balance.Equal(decimal.RequireFromString("12.5")) || !slices.Equal(ann.Tags, []string{"a", "b"}) ||
		ann.Home.V.Street.V != "Main" || ann.Profile.V.Name != "Ann" || ann.Status != app.UserStatusActive {
		t.Fatalf("read = %+v, %v", ann, err)
	}

	_, err = db.Run(app.Users.Insert(app.Users.Row().Email("ann@example.com").Status(app.UserStatusActive))).Exec(ctx)
	if !errors.Is(err, app.ErrUsersEmailKey) {
		t.Fatalf("duplicate email error = %v", err)
	}

	bob := users[1]

	for index, owner := range []int64{ann.ID, ann.ID, bob.ID} {
		row := app.Orders.Row().ID(int64(index + 1)).UserID(owner).Total(decimal.NewFromInt(int64(10 * (index + 1))))
		if _, err := db.Run(app.Orders.Insert(row)).Exec(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}

	loaded, err := db.Run(app.Users.Select().Where(app.Users.ID.Eq(ann.ID)).With(app.Users.Orders)).One(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if orders, err := loaded.Orders(); err != nil || len(orders) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("relation = %v, %v", orders, err)
	}

	rich, err := db.Run(app.Users.Select().Where(app.Users.Orders.Has(app.Orders.Total.Gt(decimal.NewFromInt(25))))).List(ctx)
	if err != nil || len(rich) != 1 || rich[0].ID != bob.ID {
		t.Fatalf("Has = %+v, %v", rich, err)
	}

	byEmail, err := db.Run(queries.UserByEmail().Email("bob@example.com")).One(ctx)
	if err != nil || byEmail.ID != bob.ID || byEmail.Status != app.UserStatusOnHold {
		t.Fatalf("UserByEmail = %+v, %v", byEmail, err)
	}

	if _, err := db.Run(queries.UserByEmail().Email("nobody@example.com")).One(ctx); !errors.Is(err, ratel.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("missing user error = %v", err)
	}

	joined, err := db.Run(queries.OrdersWithUsers()).List(ctx)
	if err != nil || len(joined) != 3 || joined[0].User == nil || joined[0].User.ID != ann.ID || joined[2].User != nil {
		t.Fatalf("OrdersWithUsers = %+v, %v", joined, err)
	}

	emails, err := db.Run(queries.Emails().Select().Where(queries.EmailsQ.ID.Eq(bob.ID))).List(ctx)
	if err != nil || len(emails) != 1 || emails[0].Email != "bob@example.com" {
		t.Fatalf("Emails builder = %+v, %v", emails, err)
	}

	tag, err := db.Run(queries.CreateTag().ID(1).Label("go")).One(ctx)
	if err != nil || tag.Label != "go" || tag.Kind != app.TagKindTopic {
		t.Fatalf("CreateTag = %+v, %v", tag, err)
	}

	brand := app.Tags.Row().ID(9).Label("acme").Kind(app.TagKindBrand)

	if _, err := db.Run(app.Tags.Insert(brand)).Exec(ctx, ratel.ExecMode(pgx.QueryExecModeSimpleProtocol)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("insert checked enum in simple protocol = %v", err)
	}

	copied, err := queries.CopyTags(ctx, db, slices.Values([]queries.CopyTagsParams{{ID: 2, Label: "sql"}, {ID: 3, Label: "pg"}}))
	if err != nil || copied != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("CopyTags = %d, %v", copied, err)
	}

	deleted, err := db.Run(queries.DeleteTag().ID(2)).Exec(ctx)
	if err != nil || deleted != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("DeleteTag = %d, %v", deleted, err)
	}

	ann.Balance = decimal.NewFromInt(99)
	if _, err := db.Run(app.Users.Save(ann)).Exec(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	saved, err := db.Run(app.Users.Select().Where(app.Users.ID.Eq(ann.ID))).One(ctx)
	if err != nil || !saved.Balance.Equal(decimal.NewFromInt(99)) {
		t.Fatalf("Save = %+v, %v", saved, err)
	}

	stale := app.Users.Save(ann).ExpectVersion(app.Users.Email, "someone@example.com")
	if _, err := db.Run(stale).Exec(ctx); !errors.Is(err, ratel.ErrStaleVersion) {
		t.Fatalf("stale Save error = %v", err)
	}

	count, err := db.Run(app.Users.Select()).Count(ctx)
	if err != nil || count != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("Count = %d, %v", count, err)
	}

	ids, err := db.Run(app.Users.Select().OrderBy(app.Users.ID.Asc()).After(ann.ID).Pluck(app.Users.ID)).List(ctx)
	if err != nil || !slices.Equal(ids, []int64{bob.ID}) {
		t.Fatalf("keyset Pluck = %v, %v", ids, err)
	}

	var (
		everyone []app.User
		single   app.User
		retagged int64
	)

	err = db.Batch(ctx,
		ratel.List(app.Users.Select().OrderBy(app.Users.ID.Asc()), &everyone),
		ratel.List(queries.Emails().Select().Where(queries.EmailsQ.ID.Eq(ann.ID)), new([]queries.EmailsRow)),
		ratel.One(app.Users.Select().Where(app.Users.ID.Eq(bob.ID)), &single),
		ratel.Exec(app.Tags.Update().Set(app.Tags.Label.To("relabeled")).All(), &retagged),
	)
	if err != nil || len(everyone) != 2 || single.ID != bob.ID || retagged != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("Batch = %v, %d users, %+v, %d tags", err, len(everyone), single, retagged)
	}

	if _, err := db.Run(app.Orders.DeleteRow(app.Order{ID: 3})).Exec(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if _, err := db.Run(app.Orders.DeleteRow(app.Order{ID: 3})).Exec(ctx); !errors.Is(err, ratel.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("second DeleteRow error = %v", err)
	}
}
